notes.title: Toodee and Topdee X UVSU Crossover - Angel and Devil skins!
notes.content:
[h1]To celebrate the announcement of my new game UVSU and it's new demo-[/h1][h1]Play as the Angel and Devil from UVSU as Toodee and Topdee![/h1][p][/p][h3]To unlock it just select the "Wishlist my new game" in the main menu and you'll unlock the skin together with an achievement :)[/h3][h3]You can toggle it on / off from the options menu.[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37865064/3bd6ed950fe58a16f0da5f48138a0be663b5f1bc.png"][/img][/p][p]
My upcoming game [b]UVSU[/b] is also a puzzle platformer with brain-melting mechanics- You play against yourself![/p][p]It also has this "you control multiple characters" things going on for it which is another similarity.[/p][p]If you played Toodee and Topdee and especially if you finished it, I'd love to hear what you think.[/p][h3]Make sure to add it to your [b]WISHLIST[/b] and check out the [b]FREE DEMO![/b][/h3][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2513270/UVSU/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3]Check out the trailer here:[/h3][previewyoutube="eiVfoM9-SWk;full"][/previewyoutube][h1][url="https://store.steampowered.com/franchise/dietzribi" style="button"]Follow my Steam Dev page[/url][/h1]

notes.title: Version 1.0.1.0
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
I've been reading reviews, comments, watching YouTube vids and streams on Twitch, and I've been working on a balance patch, and it is now live!

- Boss fights now have checkpoints! Now if you die, instead of starting from the beginning you will start from the current phase you were in. A lot less frustrating. If you want more challenge [spoiler]or the ladybugs[/spoiler] you can toggle this off in the difficulty menu.
- The second boss, Yumbrozi (the monkey) was a major pain for many, many players. So now horizontal jumps are telegraphed by a sound effect and the eyes shining, and Topdee can dodge the circular smoke effects. This gives you a lot more options! And together with the checkpoints I think this will no longer be such a frustrating experience for many players.
- Some levels that I saw that people struggle with (especially in chapter 2) were changed a little bit, hopefully they are better now.
- Many small bug fixes and performance improvements! Performance wasn't really an issue on semi-modern computers, but if you had an older one and it was lagging, it should be a lot better now!

Let me know if you run into any problems, and I hope you enjoy!

<3

EDIT: saw some streamers play and caught a few mistakes lol
Fixed them now! Newest version is 1.0.1.1

Thanks and as always let me know if you find anything!
